title: Lottus H2E
tagline: Lottus is a the First Help2Earn platform where users buy tickets to support charities. Each week, one charity and one participant win a portion of the prize pool, with unique NFTs awarded to winners and participants.
description:
Lottus is a system created to incentivize users to donate to charity by offering them a chance to earn something in return. At its core, Lottus is simple but can have a huge influence on increasing donations on the blockchain.

Talk to the charity in our post-Lottus room to get to know and connect more with the cause.

Let's change the world together, one Lottus at a time.
how_its_made:
This project is built using ScaffoldEth, which allows us to accelerate the development time for building on Ethereum. It uses two smart contracts: one for creating the Lottus and managing the fund distribution, and another for the NFTs.

It takes advantage of the Huddle protocol to run the post-Lottus talks and helps users swap their funds to Base using SquidRouter.

For the archives, it uses Lighthouse as a way to safely keep the project records transparent for anyone to see.
